title: Spike-Aware Gradient-Based Mixed-Precision Quantization of Spiking Neural Networks for Vision Applications
abstract: arXiv:2610.30339v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In recent years, Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) have gained massive attention as an energy-efficient neural computing paradigm due to their event-driven and sparse computing capability. However, maintaining accuracy under low-precision constraints, necessary for practical deployment, has been largely unexplored for SNN models. In addition, existing Hessian-based approaches for quantization, such as HAWQ-V2, incur significant memory and computational overhead due to temporal unrolling across multiple SNN timesteps. We propose a spike-aware gradient-based mixed-precision quantization framework for SNNs that adaptively assigns bit-widths using first-order gradient information, avoiding costly second-order Hessian computations. translated_title: 面向视觉应用的脉冲感知基于梯度的脉冲神经网络混合精度量化
translated_abstract: 近年来，脉冲神经网络因其事件驱动和稀疏计算能力，作为一种高能效的神经计算范式受到了广泛关注。然而，在实际部署所必需的低精度约束下保持精度，对于SNN模型而言在很大程度上尚未被探索。此外，现有的基于Hessian的量化方法（如HAWQ-V2）由于需要在多个SNN时间步上进行时间展开，会产生显著的内存和计算开销。我们提出了一种面向SNN的脉冲感知基于梯度的混合精度量化框架，该框架利用一阶梯度信息自适应地分配位宽，避免了代价高昂的二阶Hessian计算。我们在多种基于SNN的架构上评估了该方法，包括通过ANN-to-SNN转换和直接训练框架获得的VGG、ResNet和Vision Transformer模型，并在CIFAR10/100、ImageNet等数据集上进行了测试。
tldr: 提出了一种脉冲感知的基于一阶梯度的混合精度量化框架，能够自适应地为脉冲神经网络分配位宽，避免了昂贵的二阶Hessian计算开销，从而在视觉应用的低精度部署中保持模型精度。
en_tdlr: Proposes a spike-aware gradient-based mixed-precision quantization framework that adaptively assigns bit-widths to SNNs using first-order gradient information, avoiding costly second-order Hessian computations while maintaining accuracy for vision applications.
